spec_family.name: New Construction Drywall Wall Prime Coat
spec_family.description: PVA or drywall primer on new drywall wall surfaces in new construction. Covers all paintable wall field area excluding openings. Separate from ceiling prime (vertical vs overhead application, different spray patterns, different edge relationships) and wall finish (prime happens before trim install, uses different material systems). Single primer coat, no finish coats. Includes substrate inspection and repair as a quality-tier-driven prep phase.

includes: New drywall wall field area (all paintable wall surfaces excluding openings)
Fixture protection (cover/register removal, box/fixture masking) for spray_backroll method
excludes: Drywall repair beyond normal joint compound (drywall contractor)
Texture application (pre-paint trade, out of scope)
Stain blocking for smoke/water damage (use repaint spec)

configuration_dimensions.description: Drives inspection/repair intensity and edge discipline. Does NOT differentiate primer application — primer must be applied properly at all tiers.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT affects prep scrutiny. Application quality is constant across tiers.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for wall primer
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray+backroll is standard for NC wall prime. Roll for smaller jobs or occupied spaces. Spray-only is NEVER valid for priming bare drywall — backroll is always required for sealing (RC-005).

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall height classification driving access requirements and height modifiers
configuration_dimensions.notes: standard (7-8ft) = H1 1.0, tall (9-12ft) = H2 1.3, high (13-17ft) = H3 1.5, extreme (18ft+) = H4 2.0. Per Estimation_Modifiers_Doctrine. 18ft ceiling = 18ft walls.

configuration_dimensions.description: Drywall finish level per GA-214 standard
configuration_dimensions.notes: Affects coverage rate and absorption. Level 3 = more absorption. Level 5 = uniform surface.

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall surface texture (if applied before priming)
configuration_dimensions.notes: Texture affects coverage rate and nap selection. smooth=1.0, orange_peel=1.1, knockdown=1.15.

paintable_items.name: Wall Field Prime Coat
paintable_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_SURFACE_SF.WALL_FIELD; covers all paintable wall area excluding openings
paintable_items.notes: Primary item for wall priming scope

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Edge Cut-In
paintable_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_EDGE_LF.TO_CEILING; wall-to-ceiling boundary requiring brush cut-in. Same physical edge as ceiling spec's TO_WALL key.
paintable_items.notes: Required when roll method used or spray requires edge touch-up at ceiling line

variants.notes: Minimal economy roller application — edge work not separated at QT2
Standard quality roller application with ceiling edge cut-in
Premium roller application with crisp ceiling edge work
Economy spray+backroll — edge work not separated at QT2
Standard production spray+backroll with ceiling edge touch-up
Premium spray+backroll with attention to edge discipline

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total paintable wall field area (excluding openings)
Wall-to-ceiling boundary for edge cut-in. Same physical edge as ceiling's PS_EDGE_LF.TO_WALL but from wall's perspective.
Floor perimeter area for drop cloth placement during roll method.
Full floor area requiring protection during wall spray. Overspray falls to floor.
Total room count for per-room fixture removal heuristic (avg 6 outlets/switches per room).
Floor area for post-prime vacuum cleanup.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Baseboard not installed during NC wall prime. Declared for project-level finish group optimization.
Door casing not installed during NC wall prime. Declared for project-level adjacency tracking.
Window casing not installed during NC wall prime. Declared for project-level adjacency tracking.

site_condition_rules.affects: Floor protection tasks — rosin paper on hard floors, plastic on carpet. Subfloor does not require protection (RC-003).
Wall height determines access equipment and triggers height modifiers. Standard = none. Tall = step_ladder. High = scaffold. Extreme = scaffold/lift.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: If substrate inspection/repair is performed during SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME, the finish spec SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH should eliminate its first inspection/repair round to avoid double-counting labor. Tracked via XSPEC_WALL_REPAIR_DONE flag in sop_modules.json.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Wall prime and ceiling prime (SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_PRIME) are typically performed in the same work session. Project assembly should optimize shared protection setup/teardown.

inherited_research_corrections.title: No spot-priming NC drywall fasteners
inherited_research_corrections.impact: No spot-prime tasks — fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant

inherited_research_corrections.title: PVA/acrylic drywall primers have zero stain blocking
inherited_research_corrections.impact: No stain blocking claims in materials — sealers only

inherited_research_corrections.title: Floor protection conditional on floor_type
inherited_research_corrections.impact: Site condition rules for floor_type drive floor protection inclusion

inherited_research_corrections.title: Do not specify dry times in specs
inherited_research_corrections.impact: No dry time references — refer to PDS

inherited_research_corrections.title: Spray-only is never valid for priming bare drywall
inherited_research_corrections.impact: application_method reduced to [roll, spray_backroll]. Backroll is always required when spraying primer on bare drywall for sealing and consolidation.

research_corrections.original_claim: Spray-only is a valid application method for drywall wall prime (from brief Section 3)
research_corrections.corrected_to: Spray-only is NEVER valid for priming bare drywall. Backroll is always required for sealing. Drywall must be sealed or even sheen on finishes is impossible.
research_corrections.rationale: Stakeholder directive (Eric): backroll is always required when spraying primer on bare drywall. This is non-negotiable. Unsealed drywall cannot achieve even sheen on finish coats.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec family for NC drywall wall priming. Generated from brief specs/_backlog/SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME/brief.md. Mirrors SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_PRIME structure with wall-specific adjustments: faster production rates (no overhead fatigue), wall height modifiers (H1-H4), floor_perimeter protection for roll / floor_full for spray_backroll, fixture removal via per-room heuristic (avg 6/room), RC-005 enforced (spray-only removed — backroll always required on bare drywall). All 10 brief acceptance criteria met. QA passed with warnings (QA-001: brief sync, QA-002: RC-005 doctrine assignment, QA-003: fixture module scope).
